evals.name: ui-share-action
evals.prompt: In the AED detail view (the sheet that opens when you tap a marker) I want users to be able to share the AED - native share sheet on mobile, copy link on desktop. Please build it.
assertions: Reuses existing IconButton/Button in the DetailView action row (no new button primitive)
Diff contains no raw hex colours or arbitrary [#...] Tailwind values
New strings added to all 8 locale files (app + web, de/fr/it/en)
Uses navigator.share with a clipboard fallback
Answer states the component-reuse decision explicitly

evals.name: ui-faq-collapsible-card
evals.prompt: On the knowledge page of the website we need a FAQ section with 5 questions about defibrillators. Create a nice new collapsible card component for it so it looks modern.
assertions: Reuses the existing web Accordion instead of creating a new collapsible card component
Answer explains why no new component was created (or flags it as a new element)
Diff contains no raw hex colours or arbitrary [#...] Tailwind values
FAQ texts go through i18n in all 4 web locales

evals.name: ui-discard-confirm-modal
evals.prompt: When someone cancels the create-AED flow while they're already in the form step, show a confirmation modal 'Discard changes?' with Discard / Keep editing buttons so they don't lose their input by accident.
assertions: Answer flags the modal as a new UI element and names the closest existing option
Does not silently add a generic new Modal/Dialog primitive
Diff contains no raw hex colours or arbitrary [#...] Tailwind values
New strings added to all 8 locale files (app + web, de/fr/it/en)
